description: This file defines the HTTP handlers for the UI endpoints related to identity management in the agent control-plane project. It includes logic to retrieve, search, and paginate DIDs, agents, components (reasoners and skills), and verifiable credentials. The handlers interact with a storage provider to fetch data and format JSON responses for the UI client.

classes.name: IdentityHandlers
classes.description: Struct that handles the identity-related HTTP endpoints, holding a storage provider for data access.

methods.name: GetDIDStats
methods.description: Handles GET /api/ui/v1/identity/dids/stats. Retrieves statistics for agents, reasoners, and skills DIDs and returns counts.

methods.name: SearchDIDs
methods.description: Handles GET /api/ui/v1/identity/dids/search. Searches for DIDs matching a query, with filtering by type and pagination.

methods.name: ListAgents
methods.description: Handles GET /api/ui/v1/identity/agents. Lists agents with their component counts, with pagination.

methods.name: GetAgentDetails
methods.description: Handles GET /api/ui/v1/identity/agents/:agent_id/details. Retrieves detailed info about a specific agent, including its reasoners and skills, with pagination for reasoners.

methods.name: SearchCredentials
methods.description: Handles GET /api/ui/v1/identity/credentials/search. Searches for verifiable credentials with filtering by time range, workflow, status, and other parameters.

methods.name: RegisterRoutes
methods.description: Registers all the above endpoints to a gin.RouterGroup under /identity.
